### what_to_do_first.details[1]
Sentence: Because mentor insight indicates a weak referral gets a lower urgency rating in specialist care, and while the roadmap plans national referral criteria (2026–2028) and care-coordinator guidance (2026–2028, for county adoption in 2029–2031), the team recommends adopting a KYS-style referral template, referring persistent symptoms after a normal X-ray to a pulmonologist, and naming a diagnostic-phase contact person.
